name: Sharkord
author: ventordev@gmail.com
description: Self-hosted voice, video, and text chat server. Includes Caddy with Cloudflare DNS-01 SSL support.
startup: if [ ! -f ./sharkord ] || [ "{{AUTO_UPDATE}}" = "1" ]; then curl -L https://github.com/Sharkord/sharkord/releases/latest/download/sharkord-linux-x64 -o sharkord && chmod +x sharkord; fi; if [ ! -f ./caddy ]; then curl -L "https://caddyserver.com/api/download?os=linux&arch=amd64&p=github.com/caddy-dns/cloudflare" -o caddy && chmod +x caddy; fi; mkdir -p .config/sharkord; if [ ! -f .config/sharkord/config.ini ]; then echo "[server]" > .config/sharkord/config.ini; echo "port = 4991" >> .config/sharkord/config.ini; echo "" >> .config/sharkord/config.ini; echo "[webRtc]" >> .config/sharkord/config.ini; echo "port = {{RTC_PORT}}" >> .config/sharkord/config.ini; else sed -i "/^\[webRtc\]/,/^\[/ s/^[[:space:]]*port[[:space:]]*=.*/port = {{RTC_PORT}}/" .config/sharkord/config.ini; fi; if [ ! -f ./Caddyfile ]; then echo "demo.sharkord.com:{{SERVER_PORT}} {" > ./Caddyfile; echo "  tls {" >> ./Caddyfile; echo "    dns cloudflare YOUR_CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN_HERE" >> ./Caddyfile; echo "  }" >> ./Caddyfile; echo "  reverse_proxy 127.0.0.1:4991 {" >> ./Caddyfile; echo "    header_up X-Real-IP {remote_host}" >> ./Caddyfile; echo "  }" >> ./Caddyfile; echo "  header -X-Frame-Options" >> ./Caddyfile; echo "  header -Content-Security-Policy" >> ./Caddyfile; echo "  header Access-Control-Allow-Origin *" >> ./Caddyfile; echo "}" >> ./Caddyfile; ./caddy fmt --overwrite ./Caddyfile; else sed -i -E "s/demo\.sharkord\.com:[0-9]+/demo.sharkord.com:{{SERVER_PORT}}/" ./Caddyfile; ./caddy fmt --overwrite ./Caddyfile; fi; if [ "{{START_CADDY}}" = "1" ]; then if [ "{{DISABLE_CADDY_LOGS}}" = "1" ]; then ./caddy run --config ./Caddyfile > /dev/null 2>&1 & else ./caddy run --config ./Caddyfile & fi; fi; ./sharkord

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
cd /mnt/server
curl -L https://github.com/Sharkord/sharkord/releases/latest/download/sharkord-linux-x64 -o sharkord
chmod +x sharkord

curl -L "https://caddyserver.com/api/download?os=linux&arch=amd64&p=github.com/caddy-dns/cloudflare" -o caddy
chmod +x caddy

mkdir -p .config/sharkord
if [ ! -f .config/sharkord/config.ini ]; then
cat <<EOF > .config/sharkord/config.ini
[server]
port = 4991

[webRtc]
port = 40000
EOF
fi

variables.name: WebRTC Port
variables.description: The additional port allocated to the server for WebRTC voice and video media streams.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Automatically check and update the Sharkord binary on server startup.

variables.name: Start Caddy Server
variables.description: Start the built-in Caddy reverse proxy server using Caddyfile. Turned off by default (0).

variables.name: Disable Caddy Logs
variables.description: Silence all Caddy console log outputs in the server console (1 = quiet, 0 = verbose).
